// Generated by Strata from a SceneSpec. Edit freely: scene.json holds the data,
// this file interprets it with three.js.
import * as THREE from "three";
import { OrbitControls } from "three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js";
import { RoomEnvironment } from "three/addons/environments/RoomEnvironment.js";

const spec = await fetch("./scene.json").then((r) => r.json());

const canvas = document.getElementById("scene");
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
renderer.shadowMap.enabled = spec.environment.shadows;
renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
renderer.toneMappingExposure = spec.environment.exposure;

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(spec.environment.background);
if (spec.environment.fog) scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(spec.environment.fogColor, spec.environment.fogNear, spec.environment.fogFar);
if (spec.environment.preset !== "none") {
  const pmrem = new THREE.PMREMGenerator(renderer);
  scene.environment = pmrem.fromScene(new RoomEnvironment(), 0.04).texture;
  scene.environmentIntensity = spec.environment.preset === "night" ? 0.25 : spec.environment.preset === "sunset" ? 0.6 : 0.9;
}
if (spec.environment.grid) scene.add(new THREE.GridHelper(40, 40, 0x333344, 0x1c1c24));
if (spec.environment.ground) {
  const g = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(200, 200), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: spec.environment.groundColor, roughness: 1 }));
  g.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
  g.receiveShadow = true;
  scene.add(g);
}

const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(spec.camera.fov, 1, 0.1, 2000);
camera.position.fromArray(spec.camera.position);
const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, canvas);
controls.target.fromArray(spec.camera.target);
controls.enableDamping = true;
controls.autoRotate = spec.camera.autoRotate;
controls.autoRotateSpeed = spec.camera.autoRotateSpeed * 2;

function rng(seed) {
  let s = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    s = (s + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
    let t = s;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

function geometryFor(o) {
  const p = o.params;
  const seg = Math.max(3, p.detail);
  switch (o.type) {
    case "sphere": return new THREE.SphereGeometry(p.size, seg, Math.max(2, Math.round(seg * 0.75)));
    case "box": return new THREE.BoxGeometry(p.size, p.size2 || p.size, p.size3 || p.size);
    case "torus": return new THREE.TorusGeometry(p.size, p.size2, 24, seg);
    case "torusKnot": return new THREE.TorusKnotGeometry(p.size, p.size2, seg, 24);
    case "plane": return new THREE.PlaneGeometry(p.size, p.size2 || p.size);
    case "cylinder": return new THREE.CylinderGeometry(p.size, p.size, p.size2, seg);
    case "cone": return new THREE.ConeGeometry(p.size, p.size2, seg);
    case "icosahedron": return new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(p.size, Math.min(p.detail, 6));
    case "ring": return new THREE.RingGeometry(Math.min(p.size, p.size2), Math.max(p.size, p.size2), seg);
    case "terrain": {
      const g = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(p.size, p.size, seg, seg);
      const r = rng(p.seed);
      const a = [r() * 10, r() * 10, r() * 10];
      const pos = g.attributes.position;
      for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
        const x = pos.getX(i) / p.size, y = pos.getY(i) / p.size;
        const h = Math.sin(x * 6 + a[0]) * Math.cos(y * 5 + a[1]) * 0.6 + Math.sin(x * 13 + y * 11 + a[2]) * 0.25 + Math.cos(x * 23 - y * 19) * 0.1;
        pos.setZ(i, h * p.amplitude);
      }
      g.computeVertexNormals();
      g.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
      return g;
    }
    default: return null;
  }
}

function materialFor(m) {
  const common = { color: m.color, transparent: m.opacity < 1, opacity: m.opacity, wireframe: m.wireframe };
  switch (m.type) {
    case "basic": return new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial(common);
    case "normal": return new THREE.MeshNormalMaterial({ wireframe: m.wireframe, flatShading: m.flatShading });
    case "toon": return new THREE.MeshToonMaterial({ ...common, emissive: m.emissive, emissiveIntensity: m.emissiveIntensity });
    case "physical": return new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({ ...common, emissive: m.emissive, emissiveIntensity: m.emissiveIntensity, metalness: m.metalness, roughness: m.roughness, flatShading: m.flatShading, clearcoat: 0.3 });
    default: return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ ...common, emissive: m.emissive, emissiveIntensity: m.emissiveIntensity, metalness: m.metalness, roughness: m.roughness, flatShading: m.flatShading });
  }
}

function pointsFor(o) {
  const r = rng(o.params.seed);
  const n = o.params.count;
  const arr = new Float32Array(n * 3);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const rad = o.type === "starfield" ? o.params.size * (0.6 + r() * 0.4) : o.params.size * Math.cbrt(r());
    const th = r() * Math.PI * 2, ph = Math.acos(2 * r() - 1);
    arr.set([rad * Math.sin(ph) * Math.cos(th), rad * Math.sin(ph) * Math.sin(th), rad * Math.cos(ph)], i * 3);
  }
  const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(arr, 3));
  return new THREE.Points(g, new THREE.PointsMaterial({ color: o.material.color, size: o.type === "starfield" ? 0.6 : 0.06, sizeAttenuation: o.type !== "starfield", transparent: true, opacity: o.material.opacity, depthWrite: false }));
}

function textFor(o) {
  const c = document.createElement("canvas");
  const ctx = c.getContext("2d");
  const font = "600 96px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.font = font;
  const w = Math.ceil(ctx.measureText(o.params.text).width) + 40;
  c.width = w; c.height = 140;
  ctx.font = font;
  ctx.fillStyle = o.material.color;
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillText(o.params.text, 20, 70);
  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  const h = o.params.size;
  return new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry((h * w) / 140 * 1.4, h * 1.4), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: tex, transparent: true, depthWrite: false }));
}

const nodes = new Map();
const labelLayer = document.getElementById("labels");
for (const o of spec.objects) {
  const group = new THREE.Group();
  group.name = o.id;
  group.position.fromArray(o.position);
  group.rotation.set(o.rotation[0], o.rotation[1], o.rotation[2]);
  group.scale.fromArray(o.scale);
  group.visible = o.visible;
  let visual = null;
  if (o.type === "particles" || o.type === "starfield") visual = pointsFor(o);
  else if (o.type === "text") visual = textFor(o);
  else {
    const geo = geometryFor(o);
    if (geo) {
      visual = new THREE.Mesh(geo, materialFor(o.material));
      visual.castShadow = o.castShadow;
      visual.receiveShadow = o.receiveShadow;
      if (o.type === "plane" || o.type === "ring") visual.material.side = THREE.DoubleSide;
    }
  }
  if (visual) {
    visual.userData.objectId = o.id;
    group.add(visual);
  }
  let label = null;
  if (o.label) {
    label = document.createElement("div");
    label.className = "label";
    label.textContent = o.label;
    labelLayer.appendChild(label);
  }
  nodes.set(o.id, { spec: o, group, visual, label, base: { pos: group.position.clone(), scale: group.scale.clone() }, paused: false, collected: false });
}
for (const n of nodes.values()) {
  const parent = n.spec.parentId ? nodes.get(n.spec.parentId) : null;
  (parent ? parent.group : scene).add(n.group);
}

for (const l of spec.lights) {
  let light;
  switch (l.type) {
    case "ambient": light = new THREE.AmbientLight(l.color, l.intensity); break;
    case "hemisphere": light = new THREE.HemisphereLight(l.color, l.groundColor, l.intensity); break;
    case "point": light = new THREE.PointLight(l.color, l.intensity, l.distance, 2); break;
    case "spot": light = new THREE.SpotLight(l.color, l.intensity, l.distance, l.angle, 0.4, 2); break;
    default: light = new THREE.DirectionalLight(l.color, l.intensity);
  }
  light.position.fromArray(l.position);
  if (l.castShadow && "shadow" in light) {
    light.castShadow = true;
    light.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    if (light.shadow.camera.isOrthographicCamera) Object.assign(light.shadow.camera, { left: -25, right: 25, top: 25, bottom: -25 });
  }
  scene.add(light);
}

// Interactions
const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
const pointer = new THREE.Vector2();
let hovered = null;
let focusTarget = null;
function pick(e) {
  const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  pointer.set(((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * 2 - 1, -((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height) * 2 + 1);
  raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
  const hits = raycaster.intersectObjects([...nodes.values()].map((n) => n.visual).filter(Boolean), false);
  return hits.length ? nodes.get(hits[0].object.userData.objectId) : null;
}
canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
  const n = pick(e);
  if (hovered && hovered !== n && hovered.visual?.material?.emissive) hovered.visual.material.emissiveIntensity = hovered.spec.material.emissiveIntensity;
  hovered = n && n.spec.interaction === "hover-highlight" ? n : null;
  if (hovered?.visual?.material?.emissive) hovered.visual.material.emissiveIntensity = hovered.spec.material.emissiveIntensity + 0.8;
  canvas.style.cursor = n && n.spec.interaction !== "none" ? "pointer" : "";
});
canvas.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  const n = pick(e);
  if (!n) return;
  if (n.spec.interaction === "click-focus") focusTarget = n;
  if (n.spec.interaction === "click-toggle-animation") n.paused = !n.paused;
});

// Player mode
const player = spec.controls.mode === "player" ? [...nodes.values()].find((n) => n.spec.role === "player") : null;
const keys = new Set();
addEventListener("keydown", (e) => keys.add(e.key.toLowerCase()));
addEventListener("keyup", (e) => keys.delete(e.key.toLowerCase()));
const hud = document.getElementById("hud");
let score = 0;
const totalCollectibles = [...nodes.values()].filter((n) => n.spec.role === "collectible").length;
if (player) {
  hud.hidden = false;
  controls.enabled = false;
}
function updateHud(msg) {
  hud.textContent = msg ?? `Collected ${score} / ${totalCollectibles} · WASD / arrows to move`;
}
updateHud();

function resize() {
  const w = canvas.clientWidth, h = canvas.clientHeight;
  renderer.setSize(w, h, false);
  camera.aspect = w / h;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
}
addEventListener("resize", resize);
resize();

const clock = new THREE.Clock();
const tmp = new THREE.Vector3();
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => {
  const dt = Math.min(clock.getDelta(), 0.05);
  const t = clock.elapsedTime;
  for (const n of nodes.values()) {
    const a = n.spec.animation;
    if (n.paused || a.type === "none") continue;
    const target = n.visual ?? n.group;
    if (a.type === "spin") (n.visual && n.spec.type !== "group" ? n.visual : n.group).rotation[a.axis] += a.speed * dt;
    else if (a.type === "orbit") {
      const ang = a.phase + t * a.speed;
      n.group.position.set(n.base.pos.x + Math.cos(ang) * a.radius, n.base.pos.y, n.base.pos.z + Math.sin(ang) * a.radius);
    } else if (a.type === "float") n.group.position.y = n.base.pos.y + Math.sin(a.phase + t * a.speed * Math.PI * 2) * a.radius;
    else if (a.type === "pulse") target.scale.setScalar(1 + Math.sin(a.phase + t * a.speed * Math.PI * 2) * (a.radius || 0.1));
  }
  if (player) {
    const s = spec.controls.playerSpeed * dt;
    const p = player.group.position;
    if (keys.has("w") || keys.has("arrowup")) p.z -= s;
    if (keys.has("s") || keys.has("arrowdown")) p.z += s;
    if (keys.has("a") || keys.has("arrowleft")) p.x -= s;
    if (keys.has("d") || keys.has("arrowright")) p.x += s;
    const b = spec.controls.bounds;
    p.x = Math.max(-b, Math.min(b, p.x));
    p.z = Math.max(-b, Math.min(b, p.z));
    for (const n of nodes.values()) {
      if (n === player || !n.group.visible) continue;
      const d = n.group.getWorldPosition(tmp).distanceTo(p);
      if (n.spec.role === "collectible" && d < 0.9) {
        n.group.visible = false;
        score++;
        updateHud(score === totalCollectibles ? `All ${score} collected — you win!` : undefined);
      } else if (n.spec.role === "obstacle" && d < 1) {
        p.set(player.base.pos.x, player.base.pos.y, player.base.pos.z);
        updateHud("Ouch! Back to start.");
        setTimeout(() => updateHud(), 1200);
      }
    }
    camera.position.lerp(tmp.set(p.x, p.y + 10, p.z + 10), 0.08);
    camera.lookAt(p);
  } else {
    if (focusTarget) {
      focusTarget.group.getWorldPosition(tmp);
      controls.target.lerp(tmp, 0.08);
    }
    controls.update();
  }
  for (const n of nodes.values()) {
    if (!n.label) continue;
    n.group.getWorldPosition(tmp);
    tmp.y += (n.spec.params.size || 1) * n.group.scale.y + 0.2;
    tmp.project(camera);
    const visible = tmp.z < 1 && n.group.visible;
    n.label.style.display = visible ? "block" : "none";
    if (visible) n.label.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -100%) translate(${((tmp.x + 1) / 2) * canvas.clientWidth}px, ${((1 - tmp.y) / 2) * canvas.clientHeight}px)`;
  }
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
});
